title: Degree of a sum of Boolean functions
statement: For any two Boolean functions on the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb{F}_2$, the algebraic degree of their pointwise sum over $\mathbb{F}_2$ is at most the maximum of their algebraic degrees.
